description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' that implements the 'LogNode' interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the log message to the next node without additional metadata or details.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only the message part of the log, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a next LogNode in the pipeline.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message by forwarding only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
